Author: Serpens66
Name: Start Conditions
Description: Configures start resources and start troops in Stronghold Crusader Definitive Edition.

Changes: Generate Portable PDB debug symbols for Unity Mono-compatible stack traces and debugging.
Adds standalone support for the shared Script Extender per-player identity workaround.
fix game localization
Tooltip size test.
Apply gold, goods, troop types, and players independently so one failed start-condition operation does not block the remaining settings.
Resolve active players exclusively from the synchronized in-game member roster and exclude kicked or defeated slots without simulation-derived fallbacks.
Wait up to 30 seconds on simulation ticks for every active player's Keep before applying start resources and troops, then fail once with detailed readiness diagnostics.
Use Script Extender 1.41.0+'s corrected GetAlivePlayerIds result for deterministic start resources and troops, including early multiplayer Coop Trail map initialization.
Temporarily log Script Extender and legacy helper player lists side by side for multiplayer verification.
Made start gold, goods, troop multipliers, and extra troop amounts directly editable beyond compact slider ranges, with validated bounds for each setting type.
Normalized start-gold slider steps to exact hundreds and limited goods to -1 through 10000 and extra troops to 0 through 1000.
Added temporary Script Extender compatibility fixes for multiplayer settings synchronization during lobby joins, reliable lobby delivery, and authenticated in-game host updates.
Updated shared lobby settings for Script Extender 1.42.0 by avoiding redundant UI-only persistence and using the official multiplayer-game signal.
Added optional Serps Mods Host dependency for Workshop mod-pack load ordering.
Updated shared files
Highlighted activation, standardized larger tooltips, and restored the in-game term Deathmatch in German.
Added clearer start-troop subsections and opaque, automatically wrapping settings tooltips.
Delegated optional mission-preset coordination to CustomCustomTrail; local presets remain standalone.
Added mission-bound Trail presets from .modjson and CustomCustomTrail schema-2 missions, including shared customization UI.
Added two automatically saved lobby-settings presets with migration of existing settings to preset 1.
Minor internal code improvement.
Fix -Set Gold- to properly override the vanilla start gold
Added a temporary mission-override API shared with Custom Custom Trail without changing saved user settings.
